title: fix(console): a create form states identifier errors in the reader's language, and its banner wraps them
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuRvUhSZyCbMsUouh25Dmw3S)_

Fixes #28369

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：中文界面新建权限集（以及其他名称是 snake_case 标识符的元数据）时，表单上方错误横幅里关于「名称」的两条校验错误改为中文显示（「至少需要 2 个字符」「须为小写 snake_case：以字母开头……」）；英文界面仍显示 spec 原句；横幅里的每条错误改为自动换行，不再被省略号截断。
- 为什么改：中文管理员填了全中文的显示名称后，横幅却用英文说明错在哪，第二条还被截断（#28369）。按 triage 路线，按 Zod issue 的 code 和 pattern 选译文，不匹配英文原句；spec 的消息文字不动。
- 风险与回滚：只影响错误文字的显示语言和横幅换行，校验结果（能不能保存）不变；没有对应译文的错误照旧显示原文。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`（`translateSchemaIssue` 与 pattern 表）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/clientValidation.ts`（`issueDetail`，只给 `too_small` / `invalid_format` 带 detail）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`（横幅 `li` 的换行）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.identifierIssueI18n-28369.test.tsx`，预期 8 个用例全绿；或在中文界面新建权限集，显示名称填「销售运营」，横幅两条都是中文、完整换行显示。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The door carries what an issue is, not only what it says.** `validateMetadataDraft` (`clientValidation.ts`) still returns each issue's spec message unchanged, and now adds an optional `detail` (Zod `code` plus `origin` / `minimum` / `inclusive` / `format` / `pattern`) on the two codes a rendering reads: `too_small` and `invalid_format`. Every other issue keeps exactly the `{ path, message }` it had, so the existing exact-shape pins (`clientValidation.viewDiagnostics.test.ts`, `clientValidation.metricMeasureArity-8894.test.ts`) are untouched. Presentation only, after the verdict, like the two passes already there. `SchemaFormIssue` gains the optional `detail`.

**The text is picked by code and pattern.** New `translateSchemaIssue` (`i18n.ts`):

- `too_small` on a string, inclusive bound → `engine.validation.spec.stringTooShort` ("至少需要 {minimum} 个字符").
- `invalid_format` with `format: 'regex'` → a row chosen by the regex source, from a table of the spec's two identifier grammars in `shared/identifiers.zod.ts`: `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema` → `engine.validation.spec.snakeCaseIdentifier`, `SystemIdentifierSchema` → `engine.validation.spec.systemIdentifier`.
- Anything else, or no `detail` (server diagnostics, CEL lint findings) → the existing `translateValidationMessage`, unchanged.

**English stays the spec's.** The `engine.validation.spec.*` rows are zh-only in the `studio` namespace and read through `tOptional`, so an en console finds no row and shows the message `@objectstack/spec` wrote, never a copy kept in this repo (the same shape as `engine.packages.form.help.*`). The family is registered in `STUDIO_ZH_ONLY_FAMILIES` and, with its reason and anchor, in `ZH_ONLY_REASONS` / `ZH_ONLY_FLOOR` of `inspectorStrings.studioNamespace-25922.test.ts`. The other eight locales fall back to the English as for every Studio string. ⛔ No `packages/spec/**` change.

**Callers.** The summary banner and the canvas preview diagnostics in `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, and the inline field errors in `SchemaForm.tsx`, now call `translateSchemaIssue`. The banner's item is `whitespace-normal break-words` instead of `truncate`, with a `metadata-diagnostics-item` test id.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.identifierIssueI18n-28369.test.tsx` (8), the real page with the live registrations and the real served permission form, mocked client, copied from the #28232 rig:

- fixtures: the installed `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema` refuses an empty name with `too_small` then `invalid_format`; the zh rows exist.
- (a) zh-CN, label 销售运营: both banner lines are the zh rows, and none carries the spec's English (read from the installed schema).
- (b) CONTROL en-US: the banner shows the spec's own sentences.
- (c) every banner line wraps (no `truncate`).
- (d) the client door carries the detail and renders zh in zh, the spec message in en; both identifier schemas parsed live map to their zh rows; an issue without a code keeps the existing path.

<details><summary>Red on main, ablations, local runs (head c5e54f78)</summary>

Red through the real form on main: the three page files restored to the merge base `a878ff6c` (helper kept so the file imports) → `Tests 4 failed | 4 passed (8)`: (a), (b), (c) and (d)-door red; (b) is red there only because main's banner item has no test id.

Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- A1 banner back to `translateValidationMessage(i.message)` → (a) red, `1 failed | 7 passed`.
- A2 banner item back to `truncate` → (c) red, `1 failed | 7 passed`.
- A3 door drops `detail` → (a) + (d)-door red, `2 failed | 6 passed` (re-run on the final head c5e54f78, same result).
- A4 snake_case pattern row deleted → (a), (d)-door, (d)-snake red, `3 failed | 5 passed`; (d)-system stays green.
- A5 `stringTooShort` lookup removed → 4 red, `4 failed | 4 passed`.

Local, under the shared verify lock:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` exit 0 (on c5e54f78); `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` → `Test Files 684 passed (684)`, `Tests 7251 passed | 1 skipped`. The first full run (before narrowing `detail` to two codes) reds 37 exact-shape cases in two files; that run plus `packages/i18n/` and `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` was otherwise green.
- eslint on every changed file exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 34 derived commands, all exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` re-run under the lock after a queue-timeout exit 3 on the first pass); `--ran`: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (derived zero). `check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree` against #28378, #28376 and #28365 (the open PRs touching `ui/packages/i18n`): all exit 0, no conflict.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Only the two identifier grammars in `shared/identifiers.zod.ts` and the string minimum are translated. A schema with another regex (for example the dotted metadata item-name grammar) keeps its spec message in zh, as before.
- The banner's warning block is server-sourced and still unrouted through this mapping; other `translateValidationMessage` call sites (`EmbeddedItemEditor`, `PermissionMatrixEditor`, `studio-design`) render server diagnostics, which carry no issue code, and are unchanged.
- The ui/AGENTS.md #2 docs rule: no README or `content/docs/frontend/` page describes the banner's text or `SchemaFormIssue`; nothing to update.

## Verification

Live, Chromium at 820 px, own backend (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`, examples/app-showcase) and the Console dev server from this branch, Setup → Permission Sets → New, label 销售运营 (screenshots in the project folder `issue-28369/`):

- before (page files at the merge base), zh-CN: `名称: Identifier must be at least 2 characters` and the snake_case sentence, both `text-overflow: ellipsis`, the second cut (`scrollWidth > clientWidth`).
- after, zh-CN: `名称: 至少需要 2 个字符` and `名称: 须为小写 snake_case：以字母开头，只能包含字母、数字和下划线（例如 “user_profile”）`, `white-space: normal`, nothing cut.
- after, en-US: the spec's two sentences, the second wrapping onto two lines, nothing cut.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
